content: Changing an embedding model invalidates every stored vector — different models define incompatible coordinate spaces and old vectors cannot be projected into the new space. A mixed-model index (some vectors from model A, some from model B) silently corrupts retrieval quality with no error thrown. Safe migration requires either a full re-embed-and-swap of the whole corpus (needs the original source text retained, not just vectors) or an explicit dual-write/versioned-index period — never a partial/lazy re-embed left running indefinitely.
